There are {TotalGroups} groups in total: {SecurityGroups} security groups and {M365Groups} Microsoft 365 groups. {DynamicGroups} use dynamic membership. By source, {CloudGroups} are cloud-only and {OnPremisesGroups} are synced from on-premises Active Directory.
